Ghoṭakamukha
ancient authority on Arthaśāstra an. Kāmaśāstra; mentioned by Kauṭalya in Arthaśāstra (Mysore edn. 1909, p. 251) an. by Vātsyāyana in Kāmasūtra, 1. 14 a. the expounder of Kanyāsamprayuktaka section; q. by latter in Kāmasūtra I. verse 24; III. i. 3. 4; ii. 7; iii. 4; iv. 29; identified with Ghoṭakamukha in the Sutta of his name in Pāli Suttapiṭaka. See JASB. NS. XXVI. 1930, p.. 275-7.
Ref. to in Anuyogadvārasūtra (41st sutta). See Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas, p. 162, fn. 4.

Ghoṭakamukha
of Aṅga country; patronized by Aṅga King. C. 400 A. D.
--Ghoṭa(ka)mukha sutta. Maj. Nikāya, Vol. II. p. 157. [Page278-b]
On his identity with the authority on Kāma an. Artha śāstras see previous entry.
